title: x-async
description: Models event-driven interactions within an Arazzo scenario step. Provides three verbs: emit (assert event publication), await (wait for an event), and poll (poll a REST endpoint). A step may combine emit with either await or poll, but await and poll are mutually exclusive. See Arazzo Handbook §6.

emit.description: One or more events the step is expected to publish

await.description: Passively wait for a single asynchronous event matching specified criteria

poll.description: Poll a REST endpoint until a condition is met or timeout expires

not.description: await and poll are mutually exclusive within the same x-async block

eventName.description: Event name in {Entity}.{Action} PascalCase format, matching AsyncAPI x-label

event.description: Event identity in {Entity}.{Action} format. Must match an AsyncAPI message's x-label.

expect.description: Partial payload match — key/value pairs to assert on the event payload

timeout.description: ISO 8601 duration. Max wait time for the event to appear. Default: PT10S

emitItem.description: An event the step is expected to publish

event.description: Event identity in {Entity}.{Action} format. Must match an AsyncAPI message's x-label.

match.description: Key/value pairs the event payload must match. Values may use runtime expressions.

timeout.description: ISO 8601 duration. Max wait time for the event.

outputs.description: Named outputs extracted from the matched event. Values use $message.payload.X or $message.headers.X expressions.

awaitBlock.description: Wait for a single asynchronous event matching specified criteria

operationId.description: The OpenAPI operationId to call repeatedly

parameters.description: Parameters for each poll request. Values may use runtime expressions.

until.description: Arazzo simple condition that must evaluate to true for polling to stop

interval.description: ISO 8601 duration between poll attempts. Default: PT2S

timeout.description: ISO 8601 duration. Max total polling time.

pollBlock.description: Poll a REST endpoint until a condition is met or timeout expires
